A comprehensive summary for our work would be that

the proposed techniques allow the use of a conceptual rainfall-runoff model in real-time flood forecasting applications, where the model is fed by short-term rainfall predictions, which are provided by the time-series models and updated discharge predictions are obtained by the updating schemes.

the use of non-linear models such as ANNs and nearest neighbours for rainfall and discharge forecasting can improve the accuracy of the discharge forecasts, and the use of non-stationary models such as ARIMA for rainfall forecasting can improve the rainfall forecasts.

the use of the most advanced techniques in the hydrological forecasting chain can lead to an improvement in the accuracy of the discharge forecasts, especially for medium to long lead-times.
